target.meaning: MAC, normalized by trimming, lowercasing and converting hyphens to colons; the literal every is also accepted.

thing.meaning: Literal stats selects the stats reader.

ok.meaning: The outer relay completed, even if a target entry signals failure.

answers.meaning: Entries contain mac, hostname, proven, signal and answer; signal can be null or a peer/local outcome and answer can be null.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; The enum lists fixed top-level refusals. Nested answer signals include timeout, unreachable, too-large, malformed, target-unknown, seat-mac-unknown, seat-mac-mismatch and road-task-failed; refused-<HTTP status> is an open form.
